sql.query: SELECT w.id recordId,ws.id currentStageId,ws.stageName currentStageName,ws.allowNextStageEarlyStart,ws.nextWorkflowStageId,nextStage.stageName nextStageName,nextStage.status nextStageStatus,CAST(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 AND p.permissionCode='workflows.edit') AS UNSIGNED) canStart FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages ws ON ws.id=w.currentStageId AND ws.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_workflow_stages nextStage ON nextStage.id=ws.nextWorkflowStageId AND nextStage.tenantId=ws.tenantId WHERE w.id=:recordId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId2 LIMIT 1
